mechanism: Only ACTION5 advances heat; ACTION6 toggle costs a step without ticking. Heater cell +2/tick; non-heater cell -1/tick +1 per orthogonally adjacent ON heater. No two pads are adjacent, so non-heater cells cap at 1. Far cells stay 0. Win needs all 100 cells >= min_warm (4-7). Upper bound assumes heaters ON from step 0 at zero toggle cost.
